summary: Fundrise eREIT, LLC filed an 8-K to disclose a routine monthly declaration of daily distributions for August 2026. The Manager declared a daily distribution of $0.0000684930 per share, equating to approximately 0.25% annualized based on a $9.87 per share purchase price, payable to shareholders of record each day during August 2026 and scheduled for payment before October 21, 2026. The filing includes standard forward-looking statements and was signed by General Counsel Bjorn J. Hall. This is an ordinary distribution notice, not a special situation; no structural corporate event, strategic action, or deal terms are involved.
